result.stdout:
Description:
  bbx - a flight recorder for AI coding agents.

Usage:
  bbx [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  init                Set up .blackbox/ and install Claude Code hooks in this project.
  verify              Recompute the hash chain of every session and report tampering. Exit code 1 if any chain is broken.
  sessions            List recorded sessions.
  timeline <session>  Show a session as prompts and the actions they led to. Honors NO_COLOR.
  blame <file>        Show which lines were written by the agent, in which session and from which prompt.
  report <session>    Write an incident report for a session.
  investigate         Find the recorded sessions behind a commit and report the evidence.
  hook <event>        Record one Claude Code hook event from stdin (called by Claude Code).

Description:
  Set up .blackbox/ and install Claude Code hooks in this project.

Usage:
  bbx init [options]

Options:
  --uninstall     Remove bbx hooks from .claude/settings.json and .claude/settings.local.json.
  --local         Write hooks to .claude/settings.local.json with the absolute path of this bbx binary.
  --private       Add .blackbox/ to .gitignore so recordings stay on this machine.
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
